info.name: Admin API Documentation
info.description:
This documentation contains two folders of Admin API command calls:

1. Admin API calls- general command calls.
2. Affiliate Registration API- command calls relating to the registration of new affiliates in the system.
    

All command calls receive the parameters via the GET or POST method.

Each command call includes two examples- one with 'success' response, and one with 'fail' response.

**Please Note:** You will need to notify the Cellxpert Team which IP addresses will access it as it's restricted by IP.

request.description:
This command returns the list of positions\\activities. Can be filtered by userid and\\or affiliateid. The filter param is also the sorting param.

This method implements paging mechanism by two mandatory parameters:

- Limit- set the limit of records per response (limit to 5000).
    
- Offset- the offset from the beginning of the results (sorted by date).

response.body: limit parameter is required and must be a number between 1 and 5000

request.description:
This command receives the Affiliate Manager’s username and returns a one time login token for the affiliate manager’s account.

In the case that the token hasn't been used and is still active, the system will return the same pending token. Tokens expire after 20 minutes.

This token should then be used by redirecting the user to this address, using the token. IE:

 [https://go.yoursite.com/admin/loginadmin/?command=LoginWithToken&token=0717FD35-5388-47DA-BD26-D95A2CBBED5D](https://go.yoursite.com/admin/loginadmin/?command=LoginWithToken&token=0717FD35-5388-47DA-BD26-D95A2CBBED5D) 

If the token is valid, the affiliate manager will be redirected to his dashboard. If not, he will be redirected to the login page with an error.

request.description:
This command call registers a new affiliate.

The fields 'username', 'password', and 'email' only accept latin alphanumeric characters. Other fields, such as firstname/lastname, can accept other characters, like cyrillic, though it may not display correctly in the UI. 

**Additional optional text (up to 50 characters) parameters:**

PaymentMethod, PaymentCurrency, BitcoinWalletAddress, AccountBeneficiery, AccountNumber, BankName, BankBranch, BankCountry, BankCity, IBANNumber.

**Additional Custom Field (up to 250 characters) parameters:**

These are 5 additional custom fields for general uses.

CustomField1, CustomField2, CustomField3, CustomField4, CustomField5.

**GDPR**

In order to enable this functionality, you must contact the support team.

Pass the value 1 in the following parameters:

1. AgreedToTermsAndConditions
2. AgreedToPrivacyPolicy
3. AgreedToMarketingMaterial
    

Like this:

...&AgreedToTermsAndConditions=1&AgreedToPrivacyPolicy=1&AgreedToMarketingMaterial=1

**Regarding the BTA Parameter (Master Affiliate ID):**

This parameter should be collected as a querystring parameter on the affiliate public site homepage and saved on a cookie to be delivered upon registration. This parameter is used to allow for master affiliates to refer affiliates and get credit for their referrals.
